source: select symbol, date_trunc('day', ts)::date d, count(*), percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (revx_ask-revx_bid)/((revx_ask+revx_bid)/2)*1e4) from agent_basis where ts >= '2026-10-01' group by 1,2 (read-only, 2026-10-31 ~05:40 UTC): the retired trend loop's own reads of Revolut X's UK touch every 5 minutes, until its tick went off on 2026-10-29 (0160); the daily median spread in bps, 2026-10-01 -> 10-28 (10-29: 7 reads)

by_stablecoin_maker_presence.source: with m as (select minute as mn, present from agent_maker_minutes where book='USDT-GBP' and minute >= '2026-10-01'), b as (select date_trunc('minute', ts) as mn, symbol, (revx_ask-revx_bid)/((revx_ask+revx_bid)/2)*1e4 as sp from agent_basis where ts >= '2026-10-01') select symbol, (m.present <> 'none') as maker_on, count(*), p50, p90 of sp from b join m using (mn) group by 1,2
by_stablecoin_maker_presence.columns: [reads, median spread bps, p90 spread bps]
